description: Source code for the ChutesHandler class, which manages API interactions with the Chutes AI service, including streaming and non-streaming completions, model configuration, and handling specific model types like DeepSeek-R1.

classes.name: ChutesHandler
classes.description: A class that extends RouterProvider to handle API requests to the Chutes AI service, supporting streaming and non-streaming completions, with special handling for DeepSeek-R1 models.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the ChutesHandler with API options, setting default model IDs and info.

methods.name: getCompletionParams
methods.description: Prepares parameters for chat completion API calls, including model, tokens, messages, and optional temperature.

methods.name: createMessage
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a message stream, handling DeepSeek-R1 models with custom XML matching and standard OpenAI streaming for others.

methods.name: completePrompt
methods.description: Completes a prompt using the API, with model-specific temperature settings and error handling.

methods.name: getModel
methods.description: Retrieves the current model, adjusting temperature for DeepSeek-R1 models.
